goods.label: metal concentrate
goods.note: Ceres's export and the Kasei refinery's input. Binned at about 2.5 t to the cubic metre, a tonne packs to 400 L, so it weighs out before it cubes out.

goods.label: water ice
goods.note: Occator's water, bound for Phobos. Solid ice in insulated canisters packs to 1,400 L a tonne, so it cubes out before it weighs out.

goods.label: structural alloy stock
goods.note: Kasei's output, banded bar and plate: the dense return cargo, 300 L a tonne.

goods.label: yard fittings, crated
goods.note: Pressure fittings, ducting and tank sections for the Co-op fleet and the Kirkwood tank farm, crated with dunnage at about 0.43 t to the cubic metre: the bulky return cargo, 2,300 L a tonne.

goods.label: reaction mass
goods.note: Burned at departure. Tank-rated: the tank limits mass only, so its 1,000 L a tonne is never summed against a hold.

goods.label: voyage provisions
goods.note: One crew-day a unit, 4 kg and 10 L, ten to the case; a passage burns its occupants times each leg's whole IC days.

goods.label: instrument boards, crated
goods.note: Boards from the chartered Earth-basin fabs, forwarded through Luna in shock crates at about 0.39 t to the cubic metre: the bulky, dear partner of lunar alloy stock, 2,550 L a tonne, so it cubes out at 47 t. Not tacsim.electronics, which doc 17 keeps for the die lots.

goods.label: carbon billet, pressed
goods.note: Titan's tholins and paraffins pyrolysed and pressed to graphite billet at about 1.67 t to the cubic metre: the dense Titan cargo, 600 L a tonne, the partner of the lifters' overburden ice; feedstock for Luna's closed loops and Mars's soil.

goods.label: metal ore, run-of-mine
goods.note: Drilled from a Registry site's metal blocks and bought only at Ceres, where the Exchange mills it five to two into metal concentrate. Broken rock at about 2 t to the cubic metre packs to 500 L a tonne. The reference is the Exchange's bid that cut SM.5 posts.

goods.label: ice ore, run-of-mine
goods.note: Dirty ice drilled from a Registry site's ice blocks and bought only at Ceres, where Occator mills it five to two into water ice. Lumped at about a tonne to the cubic metre, it packs to 1,000 L a tonne. The reference is Occator's bid that cut SM.5 posts.

goods.label: carbon ore, run-of-mine
goods.note: Carbonaceous clay and organics drilled from a Registry site and bought only at Ceres; no mill takes it in phase 1, so the Exchange stocks it for a later feedstock ask. Loose at about 0.83 t to the cubic metre, it packs to 1,200 L a tonne and cubes out in a hopper. The reference is the Exchange's bid that cut SM.5 posts.

goods.label: strategic ore, run-of-mine
goods.note: Rare-earth and platinum-group rock drilled from a Registry site and bought only at Ceres; no mill takes it in phase 1, so it waits on the Exchange's prize shelf. Broken rock at about 1.67 t to the cubic metre packs to 600 L a tonne. The reference is the Exchange's bid that cut SM.5 posts.

goods.label: 30 mm AP rounds
goods.note: Doc 36 cut GC.7. A 30 mm round is about 0.9 kg complete; linked and canned it packs to a litre, so it is counted whole. 12 cr a round makes the scout car's 240-round load 2,880 cr: precious enough to count, cheap enough to fire.

goods.label: 7.62 mm ball, boxed
goods.note: Doc 36 cut GC.7. A box is 100 linked rounds, about 2.5 kg of cartridges and half a kilo of links and can: a round alone would weigh under the table's 1 kg grain. The coaxial's 2,000-round belt is twenty boxes, 500 cr.

goods.label: 105 mm HE rounds
goods.note: Doc 36 cut GC.7. A complete 105 mm HE round is about 21 kg and ships in a 30 L tube container. 150 cr a round makes the line tank's 40-round load 6,000 cr, about a sixteenth of the tank: the reason a tank comes home with rounds left.

goods.label: anti-armour missiles, canistered
goods.note: Doc 36 cut GC.7. A vehicle missile in its launch canister, about 50 kg and 100 L crated. 1,500 cr a round makes the heavy's six-round rack 9,000 cr: the dearest thing a unit fires.
